::: {#cor-deviance-drop-distribution}

#### Distribution of the drop in deviance

Suppose the regularity conditions of [Wilks' theorem](intro-MLEs.qmd#thm-wilks) hold for the logistic regression model. Then for a large sample the drop in deviance $\nulldeviance - \deviance$ has approximately a $\chi^2_q$ distribution when $H_0$ holds.

:::

::: proof
By @thm-deviance-drop the drop in deviance is the likelihood ratio statistic of $q$ constraints, and [Wilks' theorem](intro-MLEs.qmd#thm-wilks) gives its approximate distribution.
:::
